title: Modified PowerMax Soil Kit Protocol for DNA Extraction from Sediment or Water Filters
author: Lauren Lui
materials: Let sample warm to room temperature (~30-60 mins).

steps.title: Prepare Sample and Initial Lysis
steps.instruction: Combine sample with garnet beads and lysis solution.

substeps.instruction: Pour garnet beads into a 50 ml centrifuge tube containing ~5 g sediment or torn water filter.
Add 15 ml of PowerBead solution to the tube.
Vortex on high for 1 minute, shaking to ensure filter pieces are covered by liquid and settled at the bottom.

steps.title: Prepare Solution C1
steps.instruction: Ensure Solution C1 (SDS solution) is fully dissolved.

substeps.instruction: If Solution C1 is precipitated, heat to 60°C until dissolved before use.

steps.title: Freeze and Thaw Cycle
steps.instruction: Perform a deep freeze and thaw to disrupt cells.

substeps.instruction: Deep freeze tubes at -20°C or -80°C for at least one hour or overnight.
Thaw tubes at room temperature (approximately 45 minutes).
Vortex on high for 3.5 minutes.
Incubate tubes for 30 min at 65°C in a water bath, inverting 10x every 10 minutes.
Centrifuge tubes at 2500 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant (including bubbles) to a clean Collection Tube.

steps.title: Chemical Purification
steps.instruction: Sequentially add purification solutions to the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 ml of Solution C2 and invert twice to mix.
Add 4 ml of Solution C3 and invert twice to mix.
Shake to mix Solution C4, then add 30 ml of Solution C4 and invert twice.

steps.title: Filter Loading and Washing
steps.instruction: Pass the sample through a spin filter and wash.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 ml of Solution C5 to the Spin Filter.
Carefully place the Spin Filter in a clean 50 mL tube, avoiding splashing Solution C5 onto the filter.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute DNA from the spin filter membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 ml of warm Solution C6 (55°C) to the center of the Spin Filter membrane.
Optional: Repeat elution with another 5 mL of Solution C6 to improve yield.

steps.title: Low Biomass Processing (Optional)
steps.instruction: Perform these steps if total DNA is <1 µg (Qubit concentration <0.1ng/uL if eluted in 10mL).

substeps.instruction: Using autoclaved tweezers in a biosafety cabinet, tear up water filters and place pieces in a tube, avoiding touching the inner filter part.
Add 1.2 ml of Solution C1 to a PowerMax Bead Solution Tube and vortex on high for 30 seconds.
Centrifuge tubes at 2500 x g for 4 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer supernatant to a clean Collection Tube, avoiding the pellet (extra spin may be required).
Centrifuge tubes again at 2500 x g for 4 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer supernatant to a clean Collection Tube, avoiding the pellet.
Incubate at 4°C for at least 30 minutes.
Load the sample onto spin filters in ~15mL increments: centrifuge at 2500xg for 2 minutes, discard flow through, and repeat until the entire volume is processed.
Centrifuge at 2500 x g for 3 minutes and discard flow through.
Centrifuge the Spin Filter at 2500 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Let stand for one minute, then centrifuge at 2500 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate DNA from the eluted volume.

substeps.instruction: Add either 1 mL of 3M NaAcetate pH5.2 or 0.42mL 5M NaCl (final conc 0.2M NaCl) and mix by inversion.
Add 0.6-0.7 volumes of isopropanol (e.g., 7.3mL if using NaCl) or 2-2.5x volume of ethanol. Incubate 10 minutes at RT.
Centrifuge at 10,000G for 15-30 minutes.
Resuspend pellet overnight in 500uL of Solution C6, sterile/DNase free water, Tris, or TE.
Measure concentration on Qubit and check 260/230 and 260/280 values on Nanodrop.

steps.title: High Biomass Precipitation (Optional)
steps.instruction: Perform these steps if total DNA is >1 µg.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 3M NaAcetate pH5.2 with glycogen (0.4 mg/ml) and invert 10 times. (Alternatively, add 0.42mL 5M NaCl for 0.2M final conc; glycogen is optional).
Add 27 ml of 100% 4°C ethanol and invert 3-5 times. Incubate overnight at 4°C or -20°C.
Centrifuge at 15K x g for 30 minutes at room temperature, using the tube label to orient the pellet.
Carefully pour off the supernatant.
Wash the DNA pellet with 10mL 70% ethanol (room temperature); do not let it sit too long.
Centrifuge at room temperature for 10 minutes, maintaining the original tube orientation.
Remove tubes immediately after the centrifuge stops.
Pour off supernatant, remove residual ethanol with a pipet, and air dry in a biosafety cabinet for 10 minutes (do not overdry).
Add 500ul of Solution C6, sterile/DNase free water, TE, or 10mM Tris-Cl directly to the pellet.
Incubate by rotating and leaning the tube over the pellet; overnight incubation at room temperature is recommended.
Quantify on Qubit and check 260/230 and 260/280 values on Nanodrop.
If precipitate is present, let it sink and pipet off the top 90% into a 1.5 mL tube.
If further concentration is needed: add 50 ul of 3M NaAcetate to 500ul sample, mix, and add 1mL of 100% ethanol.
